tags.description: A one-piece hooded coverall in chalky grey polymer, seams heat-welded rather than stitched because thread wicks and wicking is how the acid gets in. The hood cinches down to a slot you see out of. It is hot, it rustles like a crisp packet, and every rainy season it is the difference between a bad afternoon and a burn ward. Wear the waders with it or your feet will make the argument for you.
